# Vendored PatchTST source subset

Original project: [yuqinie98/PatchTST](https://github.com/yuqinie98/PatchTST).
Authors: Yuqi Nie, Nam H. Nguyen, Phanwadee Sinthong, and Jayant Kalagnanam.
Paper: *A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers* (ICLR 2023).

Pinned upstream commit: `204c21efe0b39603ad6e2ca640ef5896646ab1a9`.
The six source/documentation files listed in
[`experiments/patchtst/installation.json`](../../experiments/patchtst/installation.json)
are copied byte-for-byte from upstream. They include the original Apache 2.0
`LICENSE`, `README.md`, supervised model, backbone, layers, and RevIN.
No upstream model source is modified. Runtime-generated bytecode is excluded.

This is the minimal subset used by this experiment, not a complete upstream
checkout. The upstream README describes other files and tasks that are not
bundled here. Repository-specific training, preprocessing, evaluation, and
plotting code lives under `experiments/patchtst/`.

`run_patchtst.py` checks all six file hashes before model creation. The model
is trained from scratch; this repository does not distribute pretrained
PatchTST weights or claim authorship of the PatchTST architecture.
